name: blocker-extension
description: Research prototype: ML-based ad and tracker blocking (master thesis)

scripts.build: bun run build:features && bun run build:filterlists && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.test: bun run build:features && bun run build:filterlists && vitest run
scripts.build:features: cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --manifest-path features/Cargo.toml && wasm-bindgen --target web --experimental-reset-state-function --out-dir features/pkg features/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/adflush_features.wasm
scripts.build:filterlists: cargo build --release --lib --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --manifest-path filterlists/Cargo.toml && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir filterlists/pkg filterlists/target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/filterlists.wasm && cargo run --release --manifest-path filterlists/Cargo.toml --bin compile -- filterlists/pkg filterlists/data/*.txt
